1.text: Tha words of Jeremiah tha son of Hilkiah, of tha priests dat were in Anathoth in tha land of Benjamin:
2 whom tha word of tha LORD came in tha days of Josiah tha son of Amon king of Judah, in tha thirteenth year of his reign.

It came also in tha days of Jehoiakim tha son of Josiah king of Judah, 2 tha end of tha eleventh year of Zedekiah tha son of Josiah king of Judah, 2 tha carryin away of Jerusalem captive in tha fifth month.
Then tha word of tha LORD came 2 me, sayin,
Before I formed u in tha belly I knew u; N before u came forth out of tha womb I sanctified u, N I ordained u a prophet 2 tha nations.
Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! look, I cannot speak: 4 I am a child.
But tha LORD said 2 me, Say not, I am a child: 4 u will go 2 all dat I shall send u, N whatever I command u u will speak.
Don’t be afraid of their faces: 4 I am wit u 2 deliver u, says tha LORD.
Then tha LORD put forth his hand, N touched my mouth. N tha LORD said 2 me, look, I have put my words in ur mouth.
See, I have dis day set u over tha nations N over tha kingdoms, 2 root out, N 2 pull down, N 2 destroy, N 2 throw down, 2 build, N 2 plant.
Moreover tha word of tha LORD came 2 me, sayin, Jeremiah, what see u? N I said, I see a rod of an almond tree.
Then said tha LORD 2 me, u have well seen: 4 I will hasten my word 2 perform it.
N tha word of tha LORD came 2 me tha second time, sayin, What see u? N I said, I see a seething pot; N tha face of it is toward tha north.
Then tha LORD said 2 me, Out of tha north an evil shall break forth upon all tha inhabitants of tha land.

4, look, I will call all tha families of tha kingdoms of tha north, says tha LORD; N dey shall come, N dey shall set every one his throne at tha entering of tha gates of Jerusalem, N against all tha walls of it round about, N against all tha citiez of Judah.
N I will utter my judgments against ’em touching all their wickedness, who have forsaken me, N have burned incense 2 other gods, N worshipped tha works of their own hands.
u therefore gird up ur loins, N arise, N speak 2 ’em all dat I command u: don’t be dismayed at their faces, lest I confound u before ’em.

4, look, I have made u dis day a defenced city, N an iron pillar, N brasen walls against tha whole land, against tha kings of Judah, against tha princes of it, against tha priests of it, N against tha people of tha land.
N dey shall fight against u; but dey shall not prevail against u; 4 I am wit u, says tha LORD, 2 deliver u.

2.text: Moreover tha word of tha LORD came 2 me, sayin,

Go N cry in tha ears of Jerusalem, sayin, like dis says tha LORD; I remember u, tha kindness of ur youth, tha love of thine espousals, when u went after me in tha wilderness, in a land dat was not sown.
Israel was holiness 2 tha LORD, N tha firstfruits of his increase: all dat devour him shall offend; evil shall come upon ’em, says tha LORD.
Hear y’all tha word of tha LORD, O house of Jacob, N all tha families of tha house of Israel:
Like dis says tha LORD, What iniquity have ur fathers found in me, dat dey r gone far from me, N have walked after vanity, N r become vain?

Neither said dey, Where is tha LORD dat brought us up out of tha land of Egypt, dat led us through tha wilderness, through a land of deserts N of pits, through a land of drought, N of tha shadow of death, through a land dat no man passed through, N where no man lived?
N I brought u in2 a plentiful country, 2 eat tha fruit of it N tha goodness of it; but when y’all entered, y’all defiled my land, N made mine heritage an abomination.
Tha priests said not, Where is tha LORD? N dey dat handle tha law knew me not: tha pastors also transgressed against me, N tha prophets prophesied by Baal, N walked after things dat do not profit.
So I will yet plead wit u, says tha LORD, N wit ur children’s children will I plead.
4 pass over tha isles of Chittim, N see; N send 2 Kedar, N consider diligently, N see if there be such a thing.
Has a nation changed their gods, which r yet no gods? but my people have changed their glory 4 dat which does not profit.
Be astonished, O y’all heavenz, at dis, N be horribly afraid, be y’all very desolate, says tha LORD.
4 my people have committed two evils; dey have forsaken me tha fountain of livin waterz, N hewed ’em out cisterns, broken cisterns, dat can hold no water.
Is Israel a servant? is he a homeborn slave? why is he spoiled?
Tha young lions roared upon him, N yelled, N dey made his land waste: his citiez r burned without inhabitant.
Also tha children of Noph N Tahapanes have broken tha crown of ur head.
Have u not procured dis 2 urself, in dat u have forsaken tha LORD ur God, when he led u by tha way?
N now what have u 2 do in tha way of Egypt, 2 drink tha waterz of Sihor? or what have u 2 do in tha way of Assyria, 2 drink tha waterz of tha river?

Ur own wickedness shall correct u, N ur backslidings shall reprove u: know therefore N see dat it is an evil thing N bitter, dat u have forsaken tha LORD ur God, N dat my fear is not in u, says tha Lord GOD of hosts.
4 of old time I have broken ur yoke, N burst ur bands; N u said, I will not transgress; when upon every high hill N under every green tree u wander, playing tha harlot.
Yet I had planted u a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then r u turned in2 tha degenerate plant of a strange vine 2 me?
4 though u wash u wit nitre, N take u much soap, yet thine iniquity is marked before me, says tha Lord GOD.
How can u say, I am not polluted, I have not gone after Baalim? see ur way in tha valley, know what u have done: u r a swift dromedary traversing her ways;
A wild ass used 2 tha wilderness, dat snuffeth up tha wind at her pleasure; in her occasion who can turn her away? all dey dat seek her will not weary themselves; in her month dey shall find her.
Withhold ur foot from bein unshod, N ur throat from thirst: but u said, There is no hope: no; 4 I have loved strangers, N after ’em will I go.
As tha thief is ashamed when he is found, so is tha house of Israel ashamed; dey, their kings, their princes, N their priests, N their prophets,
Sayin 2 a stock, u r my father; N 2 a stone, u have brought me forth: 4 dey have turned their back 2 me, N not their face: but in tha time of their trouble dey will say, Arise, N save us.
But where r ur gods dat u have made u? let ’em arise, if dey can save u in tha time of ur trouble: 4 according 2 tha number of ur citiez r ur gods, O Judah.
So will y’all plead wit me? y’all all have transgressed against me, says tha LORD.
In vain have I struck ur children; dey received no correction: ur own sword has devoured ur prophets, like a destroying lion.
O generation, see y’all tha word of tha LORD. Have I been a wilderness 2 Israel? a land of darkness? so say my people, We r lords; we will come no more 2 u?
Can a maid forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? yet my people have forgotten me days without number.
Why trimmest u ur way 2 seek love? therefore have u also taught tha wicked ones ur ways.
Also in ur skirts is found tha blood of tha souls of tha poor innocents: I have not found it by secret search, but upon all dese.
Yet u sayest, Because I am innocent, surely his anger shall turn from me. look, I will plead wit u, because u sayest, I have not sinned.
Why gaddest u about so much 2 change ur way? u also will be ashamed of Egypt, as u were ashamed of Assyria.
Yeah, u will go forth from him, N thine hands upon thine head: 4 tha LORD has rejected ur confidences, N u will not prosper in ’em.

3.text: Dey say, If a man put away his wife, N she go from him, N become another man’s, shall he return 2 her again? shall not dat land be greatly polluted? but u have played tha harlot wit many lovers; yet return again 2 me, says tha LORD.

Lift up ur eyes 2 tha high places, N see where u have not been lien wit. In tha ways have u sat 4 ’em, as tha Arabian in tha wilderness; N u have polluted tha land wit ur whoredoms N wit ur wickedness.
Therefore tha showers have been withholden, N there has been no latter rain; N u had a whore’s forehead, u refusedst 2 be ashamed.
Will u not from dis time cry 2 me, My father, u r tha guide of my youth?
Will he reserve his anger 4 ever? will he keep it 2 tha end? look, u have spoken N done evil things as u could.

Tha LORD said also 2 me in tha days of Josiah tha king, have u seen dat which backsliding Israel has done? she is gone up upon every high mountain N under every green tree, N there has played tha harlot.
N I said after she had done all dese things, Turn u 2 me. But she returned not. N her treacherous sister Judah saw it.

N I saw, when 4 all tha causes whereby backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away, N given her a bill of divorce; yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not, but went N played tha harlot also.
N it happened through tha lightness of her whoredom, dat she defiled tha land, N committed adultery wit stones N wit stocks.
N yet 4 all dis her treacherous sister Judah has not turned 2 me wit her whole heart, but feignedly, says tha LORD.
N tha LORD said 2 me, tha backsliding Israel has justified herself more than treacherous Judah.

Go N proclaim dese words toward tha north, N say, Return, u backsliding Israel, says tha LORD; N I will not cause mine anger 2 fall upon u: 4 I am merciful, says tha LORD, N I will not keep anger 4 ever.
Only acknowledge thine iniquity, dat u have transgressed against tha LORD ur God, N have scattered ur ways 2 tha strangers under every green tree, N y’all have not obeyed my voice, says tha LORD.
Turn, O backsliding children, says tha LORD; 4 I am married 2 u: N I will take u one of a city, N two of a family, N I will bring u 2 Zion:
N I will give u pastors according 2 mine heart, which shall feed u wit knowledge N understanding.

N it will happen, when y’all be multiplied N increased in tha land, in dose days, says tha LORD, dey shall say no more, tha ark of tha covenant of tha LORD: neither shall it come 2 mind: neither shall dey remember it; neither shall dey visit it; neither shall dat be done any more.

At dat time dey shall call Jerusalem tha throne of tha LORD; N all tha nations shall be gathered 2 it, 2 tha name of tha LORD, 2 Jerusalem: neither shall dey walk any more after tha imagination of their evil heart.
In dose days tha house of Judah shall walk wit tha house of Israel, N dey shall come together out of tha land of tha north 2 tha land dat I have given 4 an inheritance 2 ur fathers.
But I said, How shall I put u among tha children, N give u a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of tha hosts of nations? N I said, u will call me, My father; N will not turn away from me.
Surely as a wife treacherously departs from her husband, so have y’all dealt treacherously wit me, O house of Israel, says tha LORD.
A voice was heard upon tha high places, weepin N supplications of tha children of Israel: 4 dey have perverted their way, N dey have forgotten tha LORD their God.
Return, y’all backsliding children, N I will heal ur backslidings. look, we come 2 u; 4 u r tha LORD our God.
Truly in vain is salvation hoped 4 from tha hills, N from tha crowd of mountains: truly in tha LORD our God is tha salvation of Israel.
4 shame has devoured tha labour of our fathers from our youth; their flocks N their herds, their sons N their daughters.
We lie down in our shame, N our confusion covers us: 4 we have sinned against tha LORD our God, we N our fathers, from our youth even 2 dis day, N have not obeyed tha voice of tha LORD our God.

4.text: If u will return, O Israel, says tha LORD, return 2 me: N if u will put away thine abominations out of my sight, then will u not remove.
N u will swear, tha LORD lives, in truth, in judgment, N in righteousness; N tha nations shall bless themselves in him, N in him shall dey glory.
4 like dis says tha LORD 2 tha men of Judah N Jerusalem, Break up ur fallow ground, N sow not among thorns.

Circumcise y’all 2 tha LORD, N take away tha foreskins of ur heart, y’all men of Judah N inhabitants of Jerusalem: lest my fury come forth like fire, N burn dat none can quench it, because of tha evil of ur doings.
Declare y’all in Judah, N publish in Jerusalem; N say, Blow y’all tha trumpet in tha land: cry, gather together, N say, Assemble y’all, N let us go in2 tha defenced citiez.
Set up tha standard toward Zion: retire, stay not: 4 I will bring evil from tha north, N a great destruction.
Tha lion is come up from his thicket, N tha destroyer of tha Gentiles is on his way; he is gone forth from his place 2 make ur land desolate; N ur citiez shall be laid waste, without an inhabitant.
4 dis gird u wit sackcloth, lament N howl: 4 tha fierce anger of tha LORD is not turned back from us.
N it will happen at dat day, says tha LORD, dat tha heart of tha king shall perish, N tha heart of tha princes; N tha priests shall be astonished, N tha prophets shall wonder.
Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! surely u have greatly deceived dis people N Jerusalem, sayin, y’all shall have peace; whereas tha sword reaches 2 tha soul.
At dat time shall it be said 2 dis people N 2 Jerusalem, A dry wind of tha high places in tha wilderness toward tha daughter of my people, not 2 fan, nor 2 cleanse,
Even a full wind from dose places shall come 2 me: now also will I give sentence against ’em.
Look, he shall come up as clouds, N his chariots shall be as a whirlwind: his horses r swifter than eagles. woe 2 us! 4 we r spoiled.
O Jerusalem, wash thine heart from wickedness, dat u may be saved. How long shall ur vain thoughts lodge within u?
4 a voice declareth from Dan, N publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim.
Make y’all mention 2 tha nations; look, publish against Jerusalem, dat watchers come from a far country, N give out their voice against tha citiez of Judah.
As keepers of a field, r dey against her round about; because she has been rebellious against me, says tha LORD.
Ur way N ur doings have procured dese things 2 u; dis is ur wickedness, because it is bitter, because it reaches 2 thine heart.
My bowels, my bowels! I am pained at my very heart; my heart makes a noise in me; I cannot hold my peace, because u have heard, O my soul, tha sound of tha trumpet, tha alarm of war.
Destruction upon destruction is cried; 4 tha whole land is spoiled: suddenly r my tents spoiled, N my curtains in a moment.
How long shall I see tha standard, N hear tha sound of tha trumpet?
4 my people is foolish, dey have not known me; dey r sottish children, N dey have none understanding: dey r wise 2 do evil, but 2 do good dey have no knowledge.
I beheld tha earth, N, look, it was without form, N void; N tha heavenz, N dey had no light.
I beheld tha mountains, N, look, dey trembled, N all tha hills moved lightly.
I beheld, N, look, there was no man, N all tha birds of tha heavenz were fled.
I beheld, N, look, tha fruitful place was a wilderness, N all tha citiez of it were broken down at tha presence of tha LORD, N by his fierce anger.
4 like dis has tha LORD said, tha whole land shall be desolate; yet will I not make a full end.
4 dis shall tha earth mourn, N tha heavenz above be black: because I have spoken it, I have purposed it, N will not repent, neither will I turn back from it.
Tha whole city shall flee 4 tha noise of tha horsemen N bowmen; dey shall go in2 thickets, N climb up upon tha rocks: every city shall be forsaken, N not a man live in it.

N when u r spoiled, what will u do? Though u clothest urself wit crimson, though u deckest u wit ornaments of gold, though u rentest ur face wit painting, in vain will u make urself fair; ur lovers will despise u, dey will seek ur life.

4 I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, N tha anguish as of her dat brings forth her first child, tha voice of tha daughter of Zion, dat bewaileth herself, dat spreads her hands, sayin, woe is me now! 4 my soul is wearied because of murderers.

5.text: Run y’all 2 N fro through tha streets of Jerusalem, N see now, N know, N seek in tha broad places of it, if y’all can find a man, if there be any dat executes judgment, dat seeks tha truth; N I will pardon it.
N though dey say, tha LORD lives; surely dey swear falsely.

O LORD, r not ur eyes upon tha truth? u have stricken ’em, but dey have not grieved; u have consumed ’em, but dey have refused 2 receive correction: dey have made their faces harder than a rock; dey have refused 2 return.
Therefore I said, Surely dese r poor; dey r foolish: 4 dey know not tha way of tha LORD, nor tha judgment of their God.
I will get me 2 tha great men, N will speak 2 ’em; 4 dey have known tha way of tha LORD, N tha judgment of their God: but dese have altogether broken tha yoke, N burst tha bonds.

So a lion out of tha forest shall kill ’em, N a wolf of tha evenings shall spoil ’em, a leopard shall watch over their citiez: every one dat goes out thence shall be torn in pieces: because their transgressions r many, N their backslidings r increased.

How shall I pardon u 4 dis? ur children have forsaken me, N sworn by ’em dat r no gods: when I had fed ’em 2 tha full, dey then committed adultery, N assembled themselves by troops in tha harlots’ houses.
Dey were as fed horses in tha morning: every one neighed after his neighbour’s wife.
Shall I not visit 4 dese things? says tha LORD: N shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as dis?
Go y’all up upon her walls, N destroy; but make not a full end: take away her battlements; 4 dey r not tha LORD’s.
4 tha house of Israel N tha house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me, says tha LORD.
Dey have belied tha LORD, N said, It is not he; neither shall evil come upon us; neither shall we see sword nor famine:
N tha prophets shall become wind, N tha word is not in ’em: like dis shall it be done 2 ’em.
So like dis says tha LORD God of hosts, Because y’all speak dis word, look, I will make my words in ur mouth fire, N dis people wood, N it shall devour ’em.
Look, I will bring a nation upon u from far, O house of Israel, says tha LORD: it is a mighty nation, it is an ancient nation, a nation whose language u know not, neither understand what dey say.
Their quiver is as an open sepulchre, dey r all mighty men.

N dey shall eat up thine harvest, N ur bread, which ur sons N ur daughters should eat: dey shall eat up ur flocks N thine herds: dey shall eat up ur vines N ur fig trees: dey shall impoverish ur fenced citiez, in which u trustedst, wit tha sword.
Nevertheless in dose days, says tha LORD, I will not make a full end wit u.

N it will happen, when y’all shall say, so does tha LORD our God all dese things 2 us? then will u answer ’em, Like as y’all have forsaken me, N served strange gods in ur land, so shall y’all serve strangers in a land dat is not urz.
Declare dis in tha house of Jacob, N publish it in Judah, sayin,
Hear now dis, O foolish people, N without understanding; which have eyes, N see not; which have ears, N hear not:

Fear y’all not me? says tha LORD: will y’all not tremble at my presence, which have placed tha sand 4 tha bound of tha sea by a perpetual decree, dat it cannot pass it: N though tha waves of it toss themselves, yet can dey not prevail; though dey roar, yet can dey not pass over it?
But dis people has a revolting N a rebellious heart; dey r revolted N gone.
Neither say dey in their heart, Let us now fear tha LORD our God, dat gives rain, both tha former N tha latter, in his season: he reserveth 2 us tha appointed weeks of tha harvest.
Ur iniquities have turned away dese things, N ur sins have withholden good things from u.
4 among my people r found wicked men: dey lay wait, as he dat sets snares; dey set a trap, dey catch men.
As a cage is full of birds, so r their houses full of deceit: therefore dey r become great, N waxen rich.
Dey r waxen fat, dey shine: yeah, dey overpass tha deeds of tha wicked: dey judge not tha cause, tha cause of tha fatherless, yet dey prosper; N tha right of tha needy do dey not judge.
Shall I not visit 4 dese things? says tha LORD: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as dis?
A wonderful N horrible thing is committed in tha land;
Tha prophets prophesy falsely, N tha priests bear rule by their means; N my people love 2 have it so: N what will y’all do in tha end of it?

6.text: O y’all children of Benjamin, gather y’all 2 flee out of tha midst of Jerusalem, N blow tha trumpet in Tekoa, N set up a sign of fire in Beth-haccerem: 4 evil appears out of tha north, N great destruction.
I have likened tha daughter of Zion 2 a comely N delicate woman.
Tha shepherds wit their flocks shall come 2 her; dey shall pitch their tents against her round about; dey shall feed every one in his place.
Prepare y’all war against her; arise, N let us go up at noon. woe 2 us! 4 tha day goes away, 4 tha shadows of tha evening r stretched out.
Arise, N let us go by night, N let us destroy her palaces.
4 like dis has tha LORD of hosts said, Hew y’all down trees, N cast a mount against Jerusalem: dis is tha city 2 be visited; she is wholly oppression in tha midst of her.
As a fountain casts out her waterz, so she casts out her wickedness: violence N spoil is heard in her; before me continually is grief N wounds.
Be u instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from u; lest I make u desolate, a land not inhabited.
Like dis says tha LORD of hosts, dey shall throughly glean tha remnant of Israel as a vine: turn back thine hand as a grapegatherer in2 tha baskets.
2 whom shall I speak, N give warning, dat dey may hear? look, their ear is uncircumcised, N dey cannot listen: look, tha word of tha LORD is 2 ’em a reproach; dey have no delight in it.

Therefore I am full of tha fury of tha LORD; I am weary wit holding in: I will pour it out upon tha children abroad, N upon tha assembly of young men together: 4 even tha husband wit tha wife shall be taken, tha aged wit him dat is full of days.
N their houses shall be turned 2 others, wit their fields N wives together: 4 I will stretch out my hand upon tha inhabitants of tha land, says tha LORD.
4 from tha least of ’em even 2 tha greatest of ’em every one is given 2 covetousness; N from tha prophet even 2 tha priest every one deals falsely.
Dey have healed also tha hurt of tha daughter of my people slightly, sayin, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.

Were dey ashamed when dey had committed abomination? no, dey were not at all ashamed, neither could dey blush: therefore dey shall fall among ’em dat fall: at tha time dat I visit ’em dey shall be cast down, says tha LORD.
Like dis says tha LORD, Stand y’all in tha ways, N see, N ask 4 tha old paths, where is tha good way, N walk in it, N y’all shall find rest 4 ur souls. But dey said, We will not walk in it.
Also I set watchmen over u, sayin, listen 2 tha sound of tha trumpet. But dey said, We will not listen.
Therefore hear, y’all nations, N know, O congregation, what is among ’em.
Hear, O earth: look, I will bring evil upon dis people, even tha fruit of their thoughts, because dey have not listened 2 my words, nor 2 my law, but rejected it.
2 what purpose comes there 2 me incense from Sheba, N tha sweet cane from a far country? ur burnt offerings r not acceptable, nor ur sacrifices sweet 2 me.
Therefore like dis says tha LORD, look, I will lay stumblingblocks before dis people, N tha fathers N tha sons together shall fall upon ’em; tha neighbour N his friend shall perish.
Like dis says tha LORD, look, a people comes from tha north country, N a great nation shall be raised from tha sides of tha earth.
Dey shall lay hold on bow N spear; dey r cruel, N have no mercy; their voice roareth like tha sea; N dey ride upon horses, set in array as men 4 war against u, O daughter of Zion.
We have heard tha fame of it: our hands wax feeble: anguish has taken hold of us, N pain, as of a woman in travail.
Go not forth in2 tha field, nor walk by tha way; 4 tha sword of tha opp N fear is on every side.
O daughter of my people, gird u wit sackcloth, N wallow urself in ashes: make u mournin, as 4 an only son, most bitter lamentation: 4 tha spoiler shall suddenly come upon us.
I have set u 4 a tower N a fortress among my people, dat u may know N try their way.
Dey r all grievous revolters, walkin wit slanders: dey r brass N iron; dey r all corrupters.
Tha bellows r burned, tha lead is consumed of tha fire; tha founder melts in vain: 4 tha wicked r not plucked away.
Reprobate silver shall men call ’em, because tha LORD has rejected ’em.

7.text: Tha word dat came 2 Jeremiah from tha LORD, sayin,
Stand in tha gate of tha LORD’s house, N proclaim there dis word, N say, Hear tha word of tha LORD, all y’all of Judah, dat enter in at dese gates 2 worship tha LORD.
Like dis says tha LORD of hosts, tha God of Israel, Amend ur ways N ur doings, N I will cause u 2 live in dis place.
Trust y’all not in lyin words, sayin, tha temple of tha LORD, tha temple of tha LORD, tha temple of tha LORD, r dese.
4 if y’all throughly amend ur ways N ur doings; if y’all throughly execute judgment between a man N his neighbour;
If y’all oppress not tha stranger, tha fatherless, N tha widow, N shed not innocent blood in dis place, neither walk after other gods 2 ur hurt:
Then will I cause u 2 live in dis place, in tha land dat I gave 2 ur fathers, 4 ever N ever.
Look, y’all trust in lyin words, dat cannot profit.
Will y’all steal, murder, N commit adultery, N swear falsely, N burn incense 2 Baal, N walk after other gods whom y’all know not;
N come N stand before me in dis house, which is called by my name, N say, We r delivered 2 do all dese abominations?
Is dis house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in ur eyes? look, even I have seen it, says tha LORD.
But go y’all now 2 my place which was in Shiloh, where I set my name at tha first, N see what I did 2 it 4 tha wickedness of my people Israel.
N now, because y’all have done all dese works, says tha LORD, N I spoke 2 u, risin up early N speakin, but y’all heard not; N I called u, but y’all answered not;
Therefore will I do 2 dis house, which is called by my name, in which y’all trust, N 2 tha place which I gave 2 u N 2 ur fathers, as I have done 2 Shiloh.
N I will cast u out of my sight, as I have cast out all ur brothers, even tha whole seed of Ephraim.
Therefore pray not u 4 dis people, neither lift up cry nor prayer 4 ’em, neither make intercession 2 me: 4 I will not hear u.
See u not what dey do in tha citiez of Judah N in tha streets of Jerusalem?
Tha children gather wood, N tha fathers kindle tha fire, N tha women knead their dough, 2 make cakes 2 tha queen of heaven, N 2 pour out drink offerings 2 other gods, dat dey may provoke me 2 anger.
Do dey provoke me 2 anger? says tha LORD: do dey not provoke themselves 2 tha confusion of their own faces?

Therefore like dis says tha Lord GOD; look, mine anger N my fury shall be poured out upon dis place, upon man, N upon beast, N upon tha trees of tha field, N upon tha fruit of tha ground; N it shall burn, N shall not be quenched.
Like dis says tha LORD of hosts, tha God of Israel; Put ur burnt offerings 2 ur sacrifices, N eat flesh.
4 I spoke not 2 ur fathers, nor commanded ’em in tha day dat I brought ’em out of tha land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices:
But dis thing commanded I ’em, sayin, Obey my voice, N I will be ur God, N y’all shall be my people: N walk y’all in all tha ways dat I have commanded u, dat it may be well 2 u.
But dey listened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in tha counsels N in tha imagination of their evil heart, N went backward, N not forward.
Since tha day dat ur fathers came forth out of tha land of Egypt 2 dis day I have even sent 2 u all my servants tha prophets, daily risin up early N sending ’em:
Yet dey listened not 2 me, nor inclined their ear, but hardened their neck: dey did worse than their fathers.
Therefore u will speak all dese words 2 ’em; but dey will not listen 2 u: u will also call 2 ’em; but dey will not answer u.
But u will say 2 ’em, dis is a nation dat obeyeth not tha voice of tha LORD their God, nor receives correction: truth is perished, N is cut off from their mouth.
Cut off thine hair, O Jerusalem, N cast it away, N take up a lamentation on high places; 4 tha LORD has rejected N forsaken tha generation of his wrath.
4 tha children of Judah have done evil in my sight, says tha LORD: dey have set their abominations in tha house which is called by my name, 2 pollute it.
N dey have built tha high places of Tophet, which is in tha valley of tha son of Hinnom, 2 burn their sons N their daughters in tha fire; which I commanded ’em not, neither came it in2 my heart.

Therefore, look, tha days come, says tha LORD, dat it shall no more be called Tophet, nor tha valley of tha son of Hinnom, but tha valley of slaughter: 4 dey shall bury in Tophet, till there be no place.
N tha carcases of dis people shall be food 4 tha fowls of tha heaven, N 4 tha beasts of tha earth; N none shall fray ’em away.

Then will I cause 2 cease from tha citiez of Judah, N from tha streets of Jerusalem, tha voice of mirth, N tha voice of gladness, tha voice of tha bridegroom, N tha voice of tha bride: 4 tha land shall be desolate.

8.text: At dat time, says tha LORD, dey shall bring out tha bones of tha kings of Judah, N tha bones of his princes, N tha bones of tha priests, N tha bones of tha prophets, N tha bones of tha inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves:

N dey shall spread ’em before tha sun, N tha moon, N all tha host of heaven, whom dey have loved, N whom dey have served, N after whom dey have walked, N whom dey have sought, N whom dey have worshipped: dey shall not be gathered, nor be buried; dey shall be 4 dung upon tha face of tha earth.
N death shall be chosen rather than life by all tha residue of ’em dat remain of dis evil family, which remain in all tha places where I have driven ’em, says tha LORD of hosts.
Moreover u will say 2 ’em, like dis says tha LORD; Shall dey fall, N not arise? shall he turn away, N not return?
Why then is dis people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? dey hold fast deceit, dey refuse 2 return.
I listened N heard, but dey spoke not aright: no man repented him of his wickedness, sayin, What have I done? every one turned 2 his course, as tha horse rusheth in2 tha battle.
Yeah, tha stork in tha heaven knows her appointed times; N tha turtle N tha crane N tha swallow observe tha time of their comin; but my people know not tha judgment of tha LORD.
How do y’all say, We r wise, N tha law of tha LORD is wit us? look, certainly in vain made he it; tha pen of tha scribes is in vain.
Tha wise men r ashamed, dey r dismayed N taken: look, dey have rejected tha word of tha LORD; N what wisdom is in ’em?

Therefore will I give their wives 2 others, N their fields 2 ’em dat shall inherit ’em: 4 every one from tha least even 2 tha greatest is given 2 covetousness, from tha prophet even 2 tha priest every one deals falsely.
4 dey have healed tha hurt of tha daughter of my people slightly, sayin, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.

Were dey ashamed when dey had committed abomination? no, dey were not at all ashamed, neither could dey blush: therefore shall dey fall among ’em dat fall: in tha time of their visitation dey shall be cast down, says tha LORD.
I will surely consume ’em, says tha LORD: there shall be no grapes on tha vine, nor figs on tha fig tree, N tha leaf shall fade; N tha things dat I have given ’em shall pass away from ’em.

Why do we sit still? assemble y’all, N let us enter in2 tha defenced citiez, N let us be silent there: 4 tha LORD our God has put us 2 silence, N given us water of gall 2 drink, because we have sinned against tha LORD.
We looked 4 peace, but no good came; N 4 a time of health, N look trouble!

Tha snorting of his horses was heard from Dan: tha whole land trembled at tha sound of tha neighing of his strong ones; 4 dey r come, N have devoured tha land, N all dat is in it; tha city, N dose dat live in it.
4, look, I will send serpents, cockatrices, among u, which will not be charmed, N dey shall bite u, says tha LORD.
When I would comfort myself against sorrow, my heart is faint in me.

Look tha voice of tha cry of tha daughter of my people because of ’em dat live in a far country: Is not tha LORD in Zion? is not her king in her? Why have dey provoked me 2 anger wit their graven images, N wit strange vanities?
Tha harvest is past, tha summer is ended, N we r not saved.
4 tha hurt of tha daughter of my people am I hurt; I am black; astonishment has taken hold on me.
Is there no balm in Gilead; is there no physician there? why then is not tha health of tha daughter of my people recovered?

9.text: Oh dat my head were waterz, N my eyes a fountain of tears, dat I might weep day N night 4 tha killed of tha daughter of my people!
Oh dat I had in tha wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; dat I might leave my people, N go from ’em! 4 dey be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.
N dey bend their tongues like their bow 4 lies: but dey r not valiant 4 tha truth upon tha earth; 4 dey proceed from evil 2 evil, N dey know not me, says tha LORD.
Take y’all heed every one of his neighbour, N trust y’all not in any brother: 4 every brother will utterly supplant, N every neighbour will walk wit slanders.
N dey will deceive every one his neighbour, N will not speak tha truth: dey have taught their tongue 2 speak lies, N weary themselves 2 commit iniquity.
Thine habitation is in tha midst of deceit; through deceit dey refuse 2 know me, says tha LORD.
Therefore like dis says tha LORD of hosts, look, I will melt ’em, N try ’em; 4 how shall I do 4 tha daughter of my people?
Their tongue is as an arrow shot out; it speaks deceit: one speaks peaceably 2 his neighbour wit his mouth, but in heart he lays his wait.
Shall I not visit ’em 4 dese things? says tha LORD: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as dis?

4 tha mountains will I take up a weepin N wailing, N 4 tha habitations of tha wilderness a lamentation, because dey r burned up, so dat none can pass through ’em; neither can men hear tha voice of tha cattle; both tha fowl of tha heavenz N tha beast r fled; dey r gone.
N I will make Jerusalem heaps, N a den of dragons; N I will make tha citiez of Judah desolate, without an inhabitant.

Who is tha wise man, dat may understand dis? N who is he 2 whom tha mouth of tha LORD has spoken, dat he may declare it, 4 what tha land perishes N is burned up like a wilderness, dat none passes through?
N tha LORD says, Because dey have forsaken my law which I set before ’em, N have not obeyed my voice, neither walked in it;
But have walked after tha imagination of their own heart, N after Baalim, which their fathers taught ’em:
Therefore like dis says tha LORD of hosts, tha God of Israel; look, I will feed ’em, even dis people, wit wormwood, N give ’em water of gall 2 drink.
I will scatter ’em also among tha heathen, whom neither dey nor their fathers have known: N I will send a sword after ’em, till I have consumed ’em.
Like dis says tha LORD of hosts, Consider y’all, N call 4 tha mournin women, dat dey may come; N send 4 cunning women, dat dey may come:
N let ’em make haste, N take up a wailing 4 us, dat our eyes may run down wit tears, N our eyelids gush out wit waterz.
4 a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How r we spoiled! we r greatly confounded, because we have forsaken tha land, because our dwellings have cast us out.
Yet hear tha word of tha LORD, O y’all women, N let ur ear receive tha word of his mouth, N teach ur daughters wailing, N every one her neighbour lamentation.
4 death is come up in2 our windows, N is entered in2 our palaces, 2 cut off tha children from without, N tha young men from tha streets.
Speak, like dis says tha LORD, Even tha carcases of men shall fall as dung upon tha open field, N as tha handful after tha harvestman, N none shall gather ’em.
Like dis says tha LORD, don’t let tha wise man glory in his wisdom, neither let tha mighty man glory in his might, don’t let tha rich man glory in his riches:

But let him dat glorieth glory in dis, dat he understands N knows me, dat I am tha LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, N righteousness, in tha earth: 4 in dese things I delight, says tha LORD.
Look, tha days come, says tha LORD, dat I will punish all ’em which r circumcised wit tha uncircumcised;

Egypt, N Judah, N Edom, N tha children of Ammon, N Moab, N all dat r in tha utmost corners, dat live in tha wilderness: 4 all dese nations r uncircumcised, N all tha house of Israel r uncircumcised in tha heart.

10.text: Hear y’all tha word which tha LORD speaks 2 u, O house of Israel:
Like dis says tha LORD, Learn not tha way of tha heathen, N don’t be dismayed at tha signs of heaven; 4 tha heathen r dismayed at ’em.
4 tha customs of tha people r vain: 4 one cuts a tree out of tha forest, tha work of tha hands of tha workman, wit tha axe.
Dey deck it wit silver N wit gold; dey fasten it wit nails N wit hammers, dat it move not.
Dey r upright as tha palm tree, but speak not: dey must needs be borne, because dey cannot go. don’t be afraid of ’em; 4 dey cannot do evil, neither also is it in ’em 2 do good.
Forasmuch as there is none like 2 u, O LORD; u r great, N ur name is great in might.
Who would not fear u, O King of nations? 4 2 u does it appertain: forasmuch as among all tha wise men of tha nations, N in all their kingdoms, there is none like 2 u.
But dey r altogether brutish N foolish: tha stock is a doctrine of vanities.
Silver spread in2 plates is brought from Tarshish, N gold from Uphaz, tha work of tha workman, N of tha hands of tha founder: blue N purple is their clothing: dey r all tha work of cunning men.
But tha LORD is tha true God, he is tha livin God, N an everlasting king: at his wrath tha earth shall tremble, N tha nations shall not be able 2 abide his indignation.
Like dis shall y’all say 2 ’em, tha gods dat have not made tha heavenz N tha earth, even dey shall perish from tha earth, N from under dese heavenz.
He has made tha earth by his power, he has established tha world by his wisdom, N has stretched out tha heavenz by his discretion.

When he utters his voice, there is a crowd of waterz in tha heavenz, N he causes tha vapours 2 ascend from tha ends of tha earth; he makes lightnings wit rain, N brings forth tha wind out of his treasures.
Every man is brutish in his knowledge: every founder is confounded by tha graven image: 4 his molten image is falsehood, N there is no breath in ’em.
Dey r vanity, N tha work of errors: in tha time of their visitation dey shall perish.
Tha portion of Jacob is not like ’em: 4 he is tha former of all things; N Israel is tha rod of his inheritance: tha LORD of hosts is his name.
Gather up ur wares out of tha land, O inhabitant of tha fortress.
4 like dis says tha LORD, look, I will sling out tha inhabitants of tha land at dis once, N will distress ’em, dat dey may find it so.
Woe is me 4 my hurt! my wound is grievous: but I said, Truly dis is a grief, N I must bear it.
My tabernacle is spoiled, N all my cords r broken: my children r gone forth of me, N dey r not: there is none 2 stretch forth my tent any more, N 2 set up my curtains.
4 tha pastors r become brutish, N have not sought tha LORD: therefore dey shall not prosper, N all their flocks shall be scattered.
Look, tha noise of tha bruit is come, N a great commotion out of tha north country, 2 make tha citiez of Judah desolate, N a den of dragons.
O LORD, I know dat tha way of man is not in himself: it is not in man dat walks 2 direct his steps.
O LORD, correct me, but wit judgment; not in thine anger, lest u bring me 2 nothing.
Pour out ur fury upon tha heathen dat know u not, N upon tha families dat call not on ur name: 4 dey have eaten up Jacob, N devoured him, N consumed him, N have made his habitation desolate.

11.text: Tha word dat came 2 Jeremiah from tha LORD, sayin,
Hear y’all tha words of dis covenant, N speak 2 tha men of Judah, N 2 tha inhabitants of Jerusalem;
N say u 2 ’em, like dis says tha LORD God of Israel; Cursed be tha man dat obeyeth not tha words of dis covenant,

Which I commanded ur fathers in tha day dat I brought ’em forth out of tha land of Egypt, from tha iron furnace, sayin, Obey my voice, N do ’em, according 2 all which I command u: so shall y’all be my people, N I will be ur God:
Dat I may perform tha oath which I have sworn 2 ur fathers, 2 give ’em a land flowing wit milk N honey, as it is dis day. Then answered I, N said, So be it, O LORD.
Then tha LORD said 2 me, Proclaim all dese words in tha citiez of Judah, N in tha streets of Jerusalem, sayin, Hear y’all tha words of dis covenant, N do ’em.
4 I earnestly protested 2 ur fathers in tha day dat I brought ’em up out of tha land of Egypt, even 2 dis day, risin early N protesting, sayin, Obey my voice.

Yet dey obeyed not, nor inclined their ear, but walked every one in tha imagination of their evil heart: therefore I will bring upon ’em all tha words of dis covenant, which I commanded ’em 2 do; but dey did ’em not.
N tha LORD said 2 me, A conspiracy is found among tha men of Judah, N among tha inhabitants of Jerusalem.

Dey r turned back 2 tha iniquities of their forefathers, which refused 2 hear my words; N dey went after other gods 2 serve ’em: tha house of Israel N tha house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made wit their fathers.
Therefore like dis says tha LORD, look, I will bring evil upon ’em, which dey shall not be able 2 escape; N though dey shall cry 2 me, I will not listen 2 ’em.
Then shall tha citiez of Judah N inhabitants of Jerusalem go, N cry 2 tha gods 2 whom dey offer incense: but dey shall not save ’em at all in tha time of their trouble.
4 according 2 tha number of ur citiez were ur gods, O Judah; N according 2 tha number of tha streets of Jerusalem have y’all set up altars 2 dat shameful thing, even altars 2 burn incense 2 Baal.
Therefore pray not u 4 dis people, neither lift up a cry or prayer 4 ’em: 4 I will not hear ’em in tha time dat dey cry 2 me 4 their trouble.
What has my beloved 2 do in mine house, seein she has wrought lewdness wit many, N tha holy flesh is passed from u? when u do evil, then u rejoice.
Tha LORD called ur name, A green olive tree, fair, N of goodly fruit: wit tha noise of a great tumult he has kindled fire upon it, N tha branches of it r broken.

4 tha LORD of hosts, dat planted u, has pronounced evil against u, 4 tha evil of tha house of Israel N of tha house of Judah, which dey have done against themselves 2 provoke me 2 anger in offering incense 2 Baal.
N tha LORD has given me knowledge of it, N I know it: then u shewedst me their doings.

But I was like a lamb or an ox dat is brought 2 tha slaughter; N I knew not dat dey had devised devices against me, sayin, Let us destroy tha tree wit tha fruit of it, N let us cut him off from tha land of tha livin, dat his name may be no more remembered.
But, O LORD of hosts, dat judge righteously, dat triest tha reins N tha heart, let me see ur vengeance on ’em: 4 2 u have I revealed my cause.
Therefore like dis says tha LORD of tha men of Anathoth, dat seek ur life, sayin, Prophesy not in tha name of tha LORD, dat u die not by our hand:
Therefore like dis says tha LORD of hosts, look, I will punish ’em: tha young men shall die by tha sword; their sons N their daughters shall die by famine:
N there shall be no remnant of ’em: 4 I will bring evil upon tha men of Anathoth, even tha year of their visitation.

12.text: Righteous r u, O LORD, when I plead wit u: yet let me talk wit u of ur judgments: so does tha way of tha wicked prosper? so r all dey happy dat deal very treacherously?
u have planted ’em, yeah, dey have taken root: dey grow, yeah, dey bring forth fruit: u r near in their mouth, N far from their reins.
But u, O LORD, know me: u have seen me, N tried mine heart toward u: pull ’em out like sheep 4 tha slaughter, N prepare ’em 4 tha day of slaughter.
How long shall tha land mourn, N tha herbs of every field wither, 4 tha wickedness of ’em dat live in it? tha beasts r consumed, N tha birds; because dey said, He shall not see our last end.
If u have run wit tha footmen, N dey have wearied u, then how can u contend wit horses? N if in tha land of peace, in which u trustedst, dey wearied u, then how will u do in tha swelling of Jordan?
4 even ur brothers, N tha house of ur father, even dey have dealt treacherously wit u; yeah, dey have called a crowd after u: believe ’em not, though dey speak fair words 2 u.
I have forsaken mine house, I have left mine heritage; I have given tha dearly beloved of my soul in2 tha hand of her opps.
Mine heritage is 2 me as a lion in tha forest; it cries out against me: therefore have I hated it.
Mine heritage is 2 me as a speckled bird, tha birds round about r against her; come y’all, assemble all tha beasts of tha field, come 2 devour.
Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, dey have trodden my portion under foot, dey have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.
Dey have made it desolate, N bein desolate it mourns 2 me; tha whole land is made desolate, because no man lays it 2 heart.
Tha spoilers r come upon all high places through tha wilderness: 4 tha sword of tha LORD shall devour from tha one end of tha land even 2 tha other end of tha land: no flesh shall have peace.
Dey have sown wheat, but shall reap thorns: dey have put themselves 2 pain, but shall not profit: N dey shall be ashamed of ur revenues because of tha fierce anger of tha LORD.

Like dis says tha LORD against all mine evil neighbours, dat touch tha inheritance which I have caused my people Israel 2 inherit; look, I will pluck ’em out of their land, N pluck out tha house of Judah from among ’em.
N it will happen, after dat I have plucked ’em out I will return, N have compassion on ’em, N will bring ’em again, every man 2 his heritage, N every man 2 his land.
N it will happen, if dey will diligently learn tha ways of my people, 2 swear by my name, tha LORD lives; as dey taught my people 2 swear by Baal; then shall dey be built in tha midst of my people.
But if dey will not obey, I will utterly pluck up N destroy dat nation, says tha LORD.

13.text: Like dis says tha LORD 2 me, Go N get u a linen girdle, N put it upon ur loins, N put it not in water.
So I got a girdle according 2 tha word of tha LORD, N put it on my loins.
N tha word of tha LORD came 2 me tha second time, sayin,
Take tha girdle dat u have got, which is upon ur loins, N arise, go 2 Euphrates, N hide it there in a hole of tha rock.
So I went, N hid it by Euphrates, as tha LORD commanded me.
N it happened after many days, dat tha LORD said 2 me, Arise, go 2 Euphrates, N take tha girdle from thence, which I commanded u 2 hide there.
Then I went 2 Euphrates, N digged, N took tha girdle from tha place where I had hid it: N, look, tha girdle was marred, it was profitable 4 nothing.
Then tha word of tha LORD came 2 me, sayin,
Like dis says tha LORD, After dis manner will I mar tha pride of Judah, N tha great pride of Jerusalem.

Dis evil people, which refuse 2 hear my words, which walk in tha imagination of their heart, N walk after other gods, 2 serve ’em, N 2 worship ’em, shall even be as dis girdle, which is good 4 nothing.

4 as tha girdle clings 2 tha loins of a man, so have I caused 2 cleave 2 me tha whole house of Israel N tha whole house of Judah, says tha LORD; dat dey might be 2 me 4 a people, N 4 a name, N 4 a praise, N 4 a glory: but dey would not hear.

Therefore u will speak 2 ’em dis word; like dis says tha LORD God of Israel, Every bottle shall be filled wit wine: N dey shall say 2 u, Do we not certainly know dat every bottle shall be filled wit wine?

Then will u say 2 ’em, like dis says tha LORD, look, I will fill all tha inhabitants of dis land, even tha kings dat sit upon David’s throne, N tha priests, N tha prophets, N all tha inhabitants of Jerusalem, wit drunkenness.
N I will dash ’em one against another, even tha fathers N tha sons together, says tha LORD: I will not pity, nor spare, nor have mercy, but destroy ’em.
Hear y’all, N listen up; don’t be proud: 4 tha LORD has spoken.
Give glory 2 tha LORD ur God, before he cause darkness, N before ur feet stumble upon tha dark mountains, N, while y’all look 4 light, he turn it in2 tha shadow of death, N make it gross darkness.
But if y’all will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret places 4 ur pride; N mine eye shall weep sore, N run down wit tears, because tha LORD’s flock is carried away captive.
Say 2 tha king N 2 tha queen, Humble y’all, sit down: 4 ur principalities shall come down, even tha crown of ur glory.
Tha citiez of tha south shall be shut up, N none shall open ’em: Judah shall be carried away captive all of it, it shall be wholly carried away captive.
Lift up ur eyes, N look ’em dat come from tha north: where is tha flock dat was given u, ur beautiful flock?
What will u say when he shall punish u? 4 u have taught ’em 2 be captains, N as chief over u: shall not sorrows take u, as a woman in travail?
N if u say in thine heart, so come dese things upon me? 4 tha greatness of thine iniquity r ur skirts discovered, N ur heels made bare.
Can tha Ethiopian change his skin, or tha leopard his spots? then may y’all also do good, dat r accustomed 2 do evil.
Therefore will I scatter ’em as tha stubble dat passes away by tha wind of tha wilderness.
Dis is ur lot, tha portion of ur measures from me, says tha LORD; because u have forgotten me, N trusted in falsehood.
Therefore will I discover ur skirts upon ur face, dat ur shame may appear.
I have seen thine adulteries, N ur neighings, tha lewdness of ur whoredom, N thine abominations on tha hills in tha fields. woe 2 u, O Jerusalem! will u not be made clean? when shall it once be?

14.text: Tha word of tha LORD dat came 2 Jeremiah concerning tha dearth.
Judah mourns, N tha gates of it languish; dey r black 2 tha ground; N tha cry of Jerusalem is gone up.
N their nobles have sent their little ones 2 tha waterz: dey came 2 tha pits, N found no water; dey returned wit their vessels empty; dey were ashamed N confounded, N covered their heads.
Because tha ground is chapt, 4 there was no rain in tha earth, tha plowmen were ashamed, dey covered their heads.
Yeah, tha hind also calved in tha field, N forsook it, because there was no grass.
N tha wild asses did stand in tha high places, dey snuffed up tha wind like dragons; their eyes did fail, because there was no grass.
O LORD, though our iniquities testify against us, do u it 4 ur name’s sake: 4 our backslidings r many; we have sinned against u.
O tha hope of Israel, tha saviour of it in time of trouble, why should u be as a stranger in tha land, N as a wayfaring man dat turns aside 2 tarry 4 a night?
Why should u be as a man astonied, as a mighty man dat cannot save? yet u, O LORD, art in tha midst of us, N we r called by ur name; leave us not.

Like dis says tha LORD 2 dis people, like dis have dey loved 2 wander, dey have not refrained their feet, therefore tha LORD does not accept ’em; he will now remember their iniquity, N visit their sins.
Then said tha LORD 2 me, Pray not 4 dis people 4 their good.
When dey fast, I will not hear their cry; N when dey offer burnt offering N an oblation, I will not accept ’em: but I will consume ’em by tha sword, N by tha famine, N by tha pestilence.
Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! look, tha prophets say 2 ’em, y’all shall not see tha sword, neither shall y’all have famine; but I will give u assured peace in dis place.

Then tha LORD said 2 me, tha prophets prophesy lies in my name: I sent ’em not, neither have I commanded ’em, neither spoke 2 ’em: dey prophesy 2 u a false vision N divination, N a thing of nothing, N tha deceit of their heart.

Therefore like dis says tha LORD concerning tha prophets dat prophesy in my name, N I sent ’em not, yet dey say, Sword N famine shall not be in dis land; By sword N famine shall dose prophets be consumed.

N tha people 2 whom dey prophesy shall be cast out in tha streets of Jerusalem because of tha famine N tha sword; N dey shall have none 2 bury ’em, ’em, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: 4 I will pour their wickedness upon ’em.
Therefore u will say dis word 2 ’em; Let my eyes run down wit tears night N day, N let ’em not cease: 4 tha virgin daughter of my people is broken wit a great breach, wit a very grievous blow.

If I go forth in2 tha field, then look tha killed wit tha sword! N if I enter in2 tha city, then look ’em dat r sick wit famine! yeah, both tha prophet N tha priest go about in2 a land dat dey know not.
Have u utterly rejected Judah? has ur soul lothed Zion? why have u struck us, N there is no healin 4 us? we looked 4 peace, N there is no good; N 4 tha time of healin, N look trouble!
We acknowledge, O LORD, our wickedness, N tha iniquity of our fathers: 4 we have sinned against u.
Do not abhor us, 4 ur name’s sake, do not disgrace tha throne of ur glory: remember, break not ur covenant wit us.
R there any among tha vanities of tha Gentiles dat can cause rain? or can tha heavenz give showers? art not u he, O LORD our God? therefore we will wait upon u: 4 u have made all dese things.

15.text: Then said tha LORD 2 me, Though Moses N Samuel stood before me, yet my mind could not be toward dis people: cast ’em out of my sight, N let ’em go forth.

N it will happen, if dey say 2 u, where shall we go forth? then u will tell ’em, like dis says tha LORD; Such as r 4 death, 2 death; N such as r 4 tha sword, 2 tha sword; N such as r 4 tha famine, 2 tha famine; N such as r 4 tha captivity, 2 tha captivity.
N I will appoint over ’em four kinds, says tha LORD: tha sword 2 kill, N tha dogs 2 tear, N tha fowls of tha heaven, N tha beasts of tha earth, 2 devour N destroy.
N I will cause ’em 2 be removed in2 all kingdoms of tha earth, because of Manasseh tha son of Hezekiah king of Judah, 4 dat which he did in Jerusalem.
4 who shall have pity upon u, O Jerusalem? or who shall bemoan u? or who shall go aside 2 ask how u do?
u have forsaken me, says tha LORD, u r gone backward: therefore will I stretch out my hand against u, N destroy u; I am weary wit repenting.
N I will fan ’em wit a fan in tha gates of tha land; I will bereave ’em of children, I will destroy my people, since dey return not from their ways.

Their widows r increased 2 me above tha sand of tha seas: I have brought upon ’em against tha mother of tha young men a spoiler at noonday: I have caused him 2 fall upon it suddenly, N terrors upon tha city.

She dat has borne seven languishes: she has given up tha ghost; her sun is gone down while it was yet day: she has been ashamed N confounded: N tha residue of ’em will I deliver 2 tha sword before their opps, says tha LORD.
Woe is me, my mother, dat u have borne me a man of strife N a man of contention 2 tha whole earth! I have neither lent on usury, nor men have lent 2 me on usury; yet every one of ’em does curse me.
Tha LORD said, for real it shall be well wit ur remnant; for real I will cause tha opp 2 entreat u well in tha time of evil N in tha time of affliction.
Shall iron break tha northern iron N tha steel?
Ur substance N ur treasures will I give 2 tha spoil without price, N dat 4 all ur sins, even in all ur borders.
N I will make u 2 pass wit thine opps in2 a land which u know not: 4 a fire is kindled in mine anger, which shall burn upon u.
O LORD, u know: remember me, N visit me, N revenge me of my persecutors; take me not away in ur longsuffering: know dat 4 ur sake I have suffered rebuke.

I sat not in tha assembly of tha mockers, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of ur hand: 4 u have filled me wit indignation.
Why is my pain perpetual, N my wound incurable, which refuses 2 be healed? will u be altogether 2 me as a liar, N as waterz dat fail?

Therefore like dis says tha LORD, If u return, then will I bring u again, N u will stand before me: N if u take forth tha precious from tha vile, u will be as my mouth: let ’em return 2 u; but return not u 2 ’em.

N I will deliver u out of tha hand of tha wicked, N I will redeem u out of tha hand of tha terrible.

16.text: Tha word of tha LORD came also 2 me, sayin,
u will not take u a wife, neither will u have sons or daughters in dis place.
4 like dis says tha LORD concerning tha sons N concerning tha daughters dat r born in dis place, N concerning their mothers dat bare ’em, N concerning their fathers dat fathered ’em in dis land;

Dey shall die of grievous deaths; dey shall not be lamented; neither shall dey be buried; but dey shall be as dung upon tha face of tha earth: N dey shall be consumed by tha sword, N by famine; N their carcases shall be food 4 tha fowls of heaven, N 4 tha beasts of tha earth.
4 like dis says tha LORD, Enter not in2 tha house of mournin, neither go 2 lament nor bemoan ’em: 4 I have taken away my peace from dis people, says tha LORD, even lovingkindness N mercies.
Both tha great N tha small shall die in dis land: dey shall not be buried, neither shall men lament 4 ’em, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald 4 ’em:
Neither shall men tear themselves 4 ’em in mournin, 2 comfort ’em 4 tha dead; neither shall men give ’em tha cup of consolation 2 drink 4 their father or 4 their mother.
u will not also go in2 tha house of feasting, 2 sit wit ’em 2 eat N 2 drink.

4 like dis says tha LORD of hosts, tha God of Israel; look, I will cause 2 cease out of dis place in ur eyes, N in ur days, tha voice of mirth, N tha voice of gladness, tha voice of tha bridegroom, N tha voice of tha bride.

N it will happen, when u will show dis people all dese words, N dey shall say 2 u, so has tha LORD pronounced all dis great evil against us? or what is our iniquity? or what is our sin dat we have committed against tha LORD our God?
Then will u say 2 ’em, Because ur fathers have forsaken me, says tha LORD, N have walked after other gods, N have served ’em, N have worshipped ’em, N have forsaken me, N have not kept my law;
N y’all have done worse than ur fathers; 4, look, y’all walk every one after tha imagination of his evil heart, dat dey may not listen 2 me:
Therefore will I cast u out of dis land in2 a land dat y’all know not, neither y’all nor ur fathers; N there shall y’all serve other gods day N night; where I will not show u favour.
Therefore, look, tha days come, says tha LORD, dat it shall no more be said, tha LORD lives, dat brought up tha children of Israel out of tha land of Egypt;

But, tha LORD lives, dat brought up tha children of Israel from tha land of tha north, N from all tha lands where he had driven ’em: N I will bring ’em again in2 their land dat I gave 2 their fathers.

Look, I will send 4 many fishers, says tha LORD, N dey shall fish ’em; N after will I send 4 many hunters, N dey shall hunt ’em from every mountain, N from every hill, N out of tha holes of tha rocks.
4 my eyes r upon all their ways: dey r not hid from my face, neither is their iniquity hid from my eyes.
N first I will recompense their iniquity N their sin double; because dey have defiled my land, dey have filled mine inheritance wit tha carcases of their detestable N abominable things.

O LORD, my strength, N my fortress, N my refuge in tha day of affliction, tha Gentiles shall come 2 u from tha ends of tha earth, N shall say, Surely our fathers have inherited lies, vanity, N things in which there is no profit.
Shall a man make gods 2 himself, N dey r no gods?
Therefore, look, I will dis once cause ’em 2 know, I will cause ’em 2 know mine hand N my might; N dey shall know dat my name is tha LORD.: or, JEHOVAH

17.text: Tha sin of Judah is written wit a pen of iron, N wit tha point of a diamond: it is graven upon tha table of their heart, N upon tha horns of ur altars;
Whilst their children remember their altars N their groves by tha green trees upon tha high hills.
O my mountain in tha field, I will give ur substance N all ur treasures 2 tha spoil, N ur high places 4 sin, throughout all ur borders.

N u, even urself, will discontinue from thine heritage dat I gave u; N I will cause u 2 serve thine opps in tha land which u know not: 4 y’all have kindled a fire in mine anger, which shall burn 4 ever.
Like dis says tha LORD; Cursed be tha man dat trusts in man, N makes flesh his arm, N whose heart departs from tha LORD.
4 he shall be like tha heath in tha desert, N shall not see when good comes; but shall inhabit tha parched places in tha wilderness, in a salt land N not inhabited.
Blessed is tha man dat trusts in tha LORD, N whose hope tha LORD is.

4 he shall be as a tree planted by tha waterz, N dat spreads out her roots by tha river, N shall not see when heat comes, but her leaf shall be green; N shall not be careful in tha year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.

A glorious high throne from tha beginning is tha place of our sanctuary.
O LORD, tha hope of Israel, all dat forsake u shall be ashamed, N dey dat depart from me shall be written in tha earth, because dey have forsaken tha LORD, tha fountain of livin waterz.

Look, dey say 2 me, Where is tha word of tha LORD? let it come now.
As 4 me, I have not hastened from bein a pastor 2 follow u: neither have I desired tha woeful day; u know: dat which came out of my lips was right before u.
Don’t be a terror 2 me: u r my hope in tha day of evil.
Let ’em be confounded dat persecute me, but don’t let me be confounded: let ’em be dismayed, but don’t let me be dismayed: bring upon ’em tha day of evil, N destroy ’em wit double destruction.
Like dis said tha LORD 2 me; Go N stand in tha gate of tha children of tha people, whereby tha kings of Judah come in, N by tha which dey go out, N in all tha gates of Jerusalem;
N say 2 ’em, Hear y’all tha word of tha LORD, y’all kings of Judah, N all Judah, N all tha inhabitants of Jerusalem, dat enter in by dese gates:
Like dis says tha LORD; pay attention 2 y’all, N bear no burden on tha sabbath day, nor bring it in by tha gates of Jerusalem;
Neither carry forth a burden out of ur houses on tha sabbath day, neither do y’all any work, but hallow y’all tha sabbath day, as I commanded ur fathers.
But dey obeyed not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, dat dey might not hear, nor receive instruction.
N it will happen, if y’all diligently listen 2 me, says tha LORD, 2 bring in no burden through tha gates of dis city on tha sabbath day, but hallow tha sabbath day, 2 do no work in it;

Then shall there enter in2 tha gates of dis city kings N princes sittin upon tha throne of David, ridin in chariots N on horses, dey, N their princes, tha men of Judah, N tha inhabitants of Jerusalem: N dis city shall remain 4 ever.

N dey shall come from tha citiez of Judah, N from tha places about Jerusalem, N from tha land of Benjamin, N from tha plain, N from tha mountains, N from tha south, bringin burnt offerings, N sacrifices, N food offerings, N incense, N bringin sacrifices of praise, 2 tha house of tha LORD.

But if y’all will not listen 2 me 2 hallow tha sabbath day, N not 2 bear a burden, even entering in at tha gates of Jerusalem on tha sabbath day; then will I kindle a fire in tha gates of it, N it shall devour tha palaces of Jerusalem, N it shall not be quenched.

18.text: Tha word which came 2 Jeremiah from tha LORD, sayin,
Arise, N go down 2 tha potter’s house, N there I will cause u 2 hear my words.

N tha vessel dat he made of clay was marred in tha hand of tha potter: so he made it again another vessel, as seemed good 2 tha potter 2 make it.
Then tha word of tha LORD came 2 me, sayin,
O house of Israel, cannot I do wit u as dis potter? says tha LORD. look, as tha clay is in tha potter’s hand, so r y’all in mine hand, O house of Israel.
At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, N concerning a kingdom, 2 pluck up, N 2 pull down, N 2 destroy it;
If dat nation, against whom I have pronounced, turn from their evil, I will repent of tha evil dat I thought 2 do 2 ’em.
N at what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, N concerning a kingdom, 2 build N 2 plant it;
If it do evil in my sight, dat it obey not my voice, then I will repent of tha good, wherewith I said I would benefit ’em.

Now therefore go 2, speak 2 tha men of Judah, N 2 tha inhabitants of Jerusalem, sayin, like dis says tha LORD; look, I frame evil against u, N devise a device against u: return y’all now every one from his evil way, N make ur ways N ur doings good.
N dey said, There is no hope: but we will walk after our own devices, N we will every one do tha imagination of his evil heart.
Therefore like dis says tha LORD; Ask y’all now among tha heathen, who has heard such things: tha virgin of Israel has done a very horrible thing.
Will a man leave tha snow of Lebanon which comes from tha rock of tha field? or shall tha cold flowing waterz dat come from another place be forsaken?
Because my people has forgotten me, dey have burned incense 2 vanity, N dey have caused ’em 2 stumble in their ways from tha ancient paths, 2 walk in paths, in a way not cast up;
2 make their land desolate, N a perpetual hissing; every one dat passes by dat shall be astonished, N wag his head.
I will scatter ’em as wit an east wind before tha opp; I will show ’em tha back, N not tha face, in tha day of their calamity.

Then said dey, Come, N let us devise devices against Jeremiah; 4 tha law shall not perish from tha priest, nor counsel from tha wise, nor tha word from tha prophet. Come, N let us strike him wit tha tongue, N let us not give heed 2 any of his words.
Give heed 2 me, O LORD, N listen 2 tha voice of ’em dat contend wit me.

Therefore deliver up their children 2 tha famine, N pour out their blood by tha force of tha sword; N let their wives be bereaved of their children, N be widows; N let their men be put 2 death; let their young men be killed by tha sword in battle.

Yet, LORD, u know all their counsel against me 2 kill me: forgive not their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from ur sight, but let ’em be overthrown before u; deal like dis wit ’em in tha time of thine anger.

19.text: Like dis says tha LORD, Go N get a potter’s earthen bottle, N take of tha ancients of tha people, N of tha ancients of tha priests;
N go forth 2 tha valley of tha son of Hinnom, which is by tha entry of tha east gate, N proclaim there tha words dat I shall tell u,

N say, Hear y’all tha word of tha LORD, O kings of Judah, N inhabitants of Jerusalem; like dis says tha LORD of hosts, tha God of Israel; look, I will bring evil upon dis place, tha which whoever hears, his ears shall tingle.

Dey have built also tha high places of Baal, 2 burn their sons wit fire 4 burnt offerings 2 Baal, which I commanded not, nor spoke it, neither came it in2 my mind:

N I will make void tha counsel of Judah N Jerusalem in dis place; N I will cause ’em 2 fall by tha sword before their opps, N by tha hands of ’em dat seek their lives: N their carcases will I give 2 be food 4 tha fowls of tha heaven, N 4 tha beasts of tha earth.

N I will cause ’em 2 eat tha flesh of their sons N tha flesh of their daughters, N dey shall eat every one tha flesh of his friend in tha siege N straitness, wherewith their opps, N dey dat seek their lives, shall straiten ’em.
Then will u break tha bottle in tha sight of tha men dat go wit u,

N will say 2 ’em, like dis says tha LORD of hosts; Even so will I break dis people N dis city, as one breaks a potter’s vessel, dat cannot be made whole again: N dey shall bury ’em in Tophet, till there be no place 2 bury.
Like dis will I do 2 dis place, says tha LORD, N 2 tha inhabitants of it, N even make dis city as Tophet:

Then came Jeremiah from Tophet, where tha LORD had sent him 2 prophesy; N he stood in tha court of tha LORD’s house; N said 2 all tha people,

20.text: Now Pashur tha son of Immer tha priest, who was also chief governor in tha house of tha LORD, heard dat Jeremiah prophesied dese things.

4 like dis says tha LORD, look, I will make u a terror 2 urself, N 2 all ur friends: N dey shall fall by tha sword of their opps, N ur eyes shall look it: N I will give all Judah in2 tha hand of tha king of Babylon, N he shall carry ’em captive in2 Babylon, N shall kill ’em wit tha sword.

N u, Pashur, N all dat live in thine house shall go in2 captivity: N u will come 2 Babylon, N there u will die, N will be buried there, u, N all ur friends, 2 whom u have prophesied lies.

4 since I spoke, I cried out, I cried violence N spoil; because tha word of tha LORD was made a reproach 2 me, N a derision, daily.

4 I heard tha defaming of many, fear on every side. Report, say dey, N we will report it. All my familiars watched 4 my halting, sayin, maybe he will be enticed, N we shall prevail against him, N we shall take our revenge on him.

But tha LORD is wit me as a mighty terrible one: therefore my persecutors shall stumble, N dey shall not prevail: dey shall be greatly ashamed; 4 dey shall not prosper: their everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten.

Sing 2 tha LORD, praise y’all tha LORD: 4 he has delivered tha soul of tha poor from tha hand of evildoers.
Cursed be tha day in which I was born: don’t let tha day in which my mother bare me be blessed.

N let dat man be as tha citiez which tha LORD overthrew, N repented not: N let him hear tha cry in tha morning, N tha shouting at noontide;
Because he killed me not from tha womb; or dat my mother might have been my grave, N her womb 2 be always great wit me.
So came I forth out of tha womb 2 see labour N sorrow, dat my days should be consumed wit shame?

21.text: Tha word which came 2 Jeremiah from tha LORD, when king Zedekiah sent 2 him Pashur tha son of Melchiah, N Zephaniah tha son of Maaseiah tha priest, sayin,

N I will strike tha inhabitants of dis city, both man N beast: dey shall die of a great pestilence.

N afterward, says tha LORD, I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, N his servants, N tha people, N such as r left in dis city from tha pestilence, from tha sword, N from tha famine, in2 tha hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, N in2 tha hand of their opps, N in2 tha hand of dose dat seek their life: N he shall strike ’em wit tha edge of tha sword; he shall not spare ’em, neither have pity, nor have mercy.
