4 I have set my face against dis city 4 evil, N not 4 good, says tha LORD: it shall be given in2 tha hand of tha king of Babylon, N he shall burn it wit fire.
N touching tha house of tha king of Judah, say, Hear y’all tha word of tha LORD;

O house of David, like dis says tha LORD; Execute judgment in tha morning, N deliver him dat is spoiled out of tha hand of tha oppressor, lest my fury go out like fire, N burn dat none can quench it, because of tha evil of ur doings.
Look, I am against u, O inhabitant of tha valley, N rock of tha plain, says tha LORD; which say, Who shall come down against us? or who shall enter in2 our habitations?
But I will punish u according 2 tha fruit of ur doings, says tha LORD: N I will kindle a fire in tha forest of it, N it shall devour all things round about it.

22.text: Like dis says tha LORD; Go down 2 tha house of tha king of Judah, N speak there dis word,
N say, Hear tha word of tha LORD, O king of Judah, dat sit upon tha throne of David, u, N ur servants, N ur people dat enter in by dese gates:

Like dis says tha LORD; Execute y’all judgment N righteousness, N deliver tha spoiled out of tha hand of tha oppressor: N do no wrong, do no violence 2 tha stranger, tha fatherless, nor tha widow, neither shed innocent blood in dis place.
4 if y’all do dis thing indeed, then shall there enter in by tha gates of dis house kings sittin upon tha throne of David, ridin in chariots N on horses, he, N his servants, N his people.
But if y’all will not hear dese words, I swear by myself, says tha LORD, dat dis house shall become a desolation.
4 like dis says tha LORD 2 tha king’s house of Judah; u r Gilead 2 me, N tha head of Lebanon: yet surely I will make u a wilderness, N citiez which r not inhabited.
N I will prepare destroyers against u, every one wit his weapons: N dey shall cut down ur choice cedars, N cast ’em in2 tha fire.
N many nations shall pass by dis city, N dey shall say every man 2 his neighbour, so has tha LORD done like dis 2 dis great city?
Then dey shall answer, Because dey have forsaken tha covenant of tha LORD their God, N worshipped other gods, N served ’em.
Weep y’all not 4 tha dead, neither bemoan him: but weep sore 4 him dat goes away: 4 he shall return no more, nor see his native country.
4 like dis says tha LORD touching Shallum tha son of Josiah king of Judah, which reigned instead of Josiah his father, which went forth out of dis place; He shall not return there any more:
But he shall die in tha place where dey have led him captive, N shall see dis land no more.
Woe 2 him dat builds his house by unrighteousness, N his chambers by wrong; dat uses his neighbour’s service without wages, N gives him not 4 his work;
Dat says, I will build me a wide house N large chambers, N cuts him out windows; N it is cieled wit cedar, N painted wit vermilion.
Will u reign, because u closest urself in cedar? did not ur father eat N drink, N do judgment N justice, N then it was well wit him?
He judged tha cause of tha poor N needy; then it was well wit him: was not dis 2 know me? says tha LORD.
But ur eyes N thine heart r not but 4 ur covetousness, N 4 2 shed innocent blood, N 4 oppression, N 4 violence, 2 do it.

Therefore like dis says tha LORD concerning Jehoiakim tha son of Josiah king of Judah; dey shall not lament 4 him, sayin, Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! dey shall not lament 4 him, sayin, Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!
He shall be buried wit tha burial of an ass, drawn N cast forth beyond tha gates of Jerusalem.
Go up 2 Lebanon, N cry; N lift up ur voice in Bashan, N cry from tha passages: 4 all ur lovers r destroyed.
I spoke 2 u in ur prosperity; but u said, I will not hear. dis has been ur manner from ur youth, dat u obeyedst not my voice.
Tha wind shall eat up all ur pastors, N ur lovers shall go in2 captivity: surely then will u be ashamed N confounded 4 all ur wickedness.
O inhabitant of Lebanon, dat make ur nest in tha cedars, how gracious will u be when pangs come upon u, tha pain as of a woman in travail!
As I live, says tha LORD, though Coniah tha son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were tha signet upon my right hand, yet would I pluck u thence;
N I will give u in2 tha hand of ’em dat seek ur life, N in2 tha hand of ’em whose face u fear, even in2 tha hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, N in2 tha hand of tha Chaldeans.
N I will cast u out, N ur mother dat bare u, in2 another country, where y’all were not born; N there shall y’all die.
But 2 tha land whereunto dey desire 2 return, there shall dey not return.
Is dis man Coniah a despised broken idol? is he a vessel in which is no pleasure? so r dey cast out, he N his seed, N r cast in2 a land which dey know not?
O earth, earth, earth, hear tha word of tha LORD.
Like dis says tha LORD, Write y’all dis man childless, a man dat shall not prosper in his days: 4 no man of his seed shall prosper, sittin upon tha throne of David, N ruling any more in Judah.

23.text: Woe be 2 tha pastors dat destroy N scatter tha sheep of my pasture! says tha LORD.

Therefore like dis says tha LORD God of Israel against tha pastors dat feed my people; y’all have scattered my flock, N driven ’em away, N have not visited ’em: look, I will visit upon u tha evil of ur doings, says tha LORD.
N I will gather tha remnant of my flock out of all countries where I have driven ’em, N will bring ’em again 2 their folds; N dey shall be fruitful N increase.
N I will set up shepherds over ’em which shall feed ’em: N dey shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall dey be lacking, says tha LORD.
Look, tha days come, says tha LORD, dat I will raise 2 David a righteous Branch, N a King shall reign N prosper, N shall execute judgment N justice in tha earth.
In his days Judah shall be saved, N Israel shall live safely: N dis is his name whereby he shall be called, tha LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS. …: Heb. Jehovah-tsidkenu
Therefore, look, tha days come, says tha LORD, dat dey shall no more say, tha LORD lives, which brought up tha children of Israel out of tha land of Egypt;
But, tha LORD lives, which brought up N which led tha seed of tha house of Israel out of tha north country, N from all countries where I had driven ’em; N dey shall live in their own land.
Mine heart within me is broken because of tha prophets; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, N like a man whom wine has overcome, because of tha LORD, N because of tha words of his holiness.
4 tha land is full of adulterers; 4 because of swearing tha land mourns; tha pleasant places of tha wilderness r dried up, N their course is evil, N their force is not right.
4 both prophet N priest r profane; yeah, in my house have I found their wickedness, says tha LORD.
So their way shall be 2 ’em as slippery ways in tha darkness: dey shall be driven on, N fall in it: 4 I will bring evil upon ’em, even tha year of their visitation, says tha LORD.
N I have seen folly in tha prophets of Samaria; dey prophesied in Baal, N caused my people Israel 2 err.

I have seen also in tha prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: dey commit adultery, N walk in lies: dey strengthen also tha hands of evildoers, dat none does return from his wickedness: dey r all of ’em 2 me as Sodom, N tha inhabitants of it as Gomorrah.

Therefore like dis says tha LORD of hosts concerning tha prophets; look, I will feed ’em wit wormwood, N make ’em drink tha water of gall: 4 from tha prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth in2 all tha land.
Like dis says tha LORD of hosts, listen not 2 tha words of tha prophets dat prophesy 2 u: dey make u vain: dey speak a vision of their own heart, N not out of tha mouth of tha LORD.
Dey say still 2 ’em dat despise me, tha LORD has said, y’all shall have peace; N dey say 2 every one dat walks after tha imagination of his own heart, No evil shall come upon u.
4 who has stood in tha counsel of tha LORD, N has perceived N heard his word? who has marked his word, N heard it?
Look, a whirlwind of tha LORD is gone forth in fury, even a grievous whirlwind: it shall fall grievously upon tha head of tha wicked.
Tha anger of tha LORD shall not return, until he have executed, N till he have performed tha thoughts of his heart: in tha latter days y’all shall consider it perfectly.
I have not sent dese prophets, yet dey ran: I have not spoken 2 ’em, yet dey prophesied.
But if dey had stood in my counsel, N had caused my people 2 hear my words, then dey should have turned ’em from their evil way, N from tha evil of their doings.
Am I a God at hand, says tha LORD, N not a God afar off?
Can any hide himself in secret places dat I shall not see him? says tha LORD. Do not I fill heaven N earth? says tha LORD.
I have heard what tha prophets said, dat prophesy lies in my name, sayin, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.
How long shall dis be in tha heart of tha prophets dat prophesy lies? yeah, dey r prophets of tha deceit of their own heart;
Which think 2 cause my people 2 forget my name by their dreams which dey tell every man 2 his neighbour, as their fathers have forgotten my name 4 Baal.
Tha prophet dat has a dream, let him tell a dream; N he dat has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is tha chaff 2 tha wheat? says tha LORD.
Is not my word like as a fire? says tha LORD; N like a hammer dat breaks tha rock in pieces?
Therefore, look, I am against tha prophets, says tha LORD, dat steal my words every one from his neighbour.
Look, I am against tha prophets, says tha LORD, dat use their tongues, N say, He says.

Look, I am against ’em dat prophesy false dreams, says tha LORD, N do tell ’em, N cause my people 2 err by their lies, N by their lightness; yet I sent ’em not, nor commanded ’em: therefore dey shall not profit dis people at all, says tha LORD.
N when dis people, or tha prophet, or a priest, shall ask u, sayin, What is tha burden of tha LORD? u will then say 2 ’em, What burden? I will even forsake u, says tha LORD.
N as 4 tha prophet, N tha priest, N tha people, dat shall say, tha burden of tha LORD, I will even punish dat man N his house.
Like dis shall y’all say every one 2 his neighbour, N every one 2 his brother, What has tha LORD answered? N, What has tha LORD spoken?
N tha burden of tha LORD shall y’all mention no more: 4 every man’s word shall be his burden; 4 y’all have perverted tha words of tha livin God, of tha LORD of hosts our God.
Like dis will u say 2 tha prophet, What has tha LORD answered u? N, What has tha LORD spoken?

But since y’all say, tha burden of tha LORD; therefore like dis says tha LORD; Because y’all say dis word, tha burden of tha LORD, N I have sent 2 u, sayin, y’all shall not say, tha burden of tha LORD;
Therefore, look, I, even I, will utterly forget u, N I will forsake u, N tha city dat I gave u N ur fathers, N cast u out of my presence:
N I will bring an everlasting reproach upon u, N a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.

24.text: Tha LORD showed me, N, look, two baskets of figs were set before tha temple of tha LORD, after dat Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah tha son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, N tha princes of Judah, wit tha carpenters N smiths, from Jerusalem, N had brought ’em 2 Babylon.
One basket had very good figs, even like tha figs dat r first ripe: N tha other basket had very naughty figs, which could not be eaten, dey were so bad.
Then said tha LORD 2 me, What see u, Jeremiah? N I said, Figs; tha good figs, very good; N tha evil, very evil, dat cannot be eaten, dey r so evil.
Again tha word of tha LORD came 2 me, sayin,

Like dis says tha LORD, tha God of Israel; Like dese good figs, so will I acknowledge ’em dat r carried away captive of Judah, whom I have sent out of dis place in2 tha land of tha Chaldeans 4 their good.
4 I will set my eyes upon ’em 4 good, N I will bring ’em again 2 dis land: N I will build ’em, N not pull ’em down; N I will plant ’em, N not pluck ’em up.
N I will give ’em an heart 2 know me, dat I am tha LORD: N dey shall be my people, N I will be their God: 4 dey shall return 2 me wit their whole heart.

N as tha evil figs, which cannot be eaten, dey r so evil; surely like dis says tha LORD, So will I give Zedekiah tha king of Judah, N his princes, N tha residue of Jerusalem, dat remain in dis land, N ’em dat live in tha land of Egypt:
N I will deliver ’em 2 be removed in2 all tha kingdoms of tha earth 4 their hurt, 2 be a reproach N a proverb, a taunt N a curse, in all places where I shall drive ’em.
N I will send tha sword, tha famine, N tha pestilence, among ’em, till dey be consumed from off tha land dat I gave 2 ’em N 2 their fathers.

25.text: Tha word dat came 2 Jeremiah concerning all tha people of Judah in tha fourth year of Jehoiakim tha son of Josiah king of Judah, dat was tha first year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon;
Tha which Jeremiah tha prophet spoke 2 all tha people of Judah, N 2 all tha inhabitants of Jerusalem, sayin,

From tha thirteenth year of Josiah tha son of Amon king of Judah, even 2 dis day, dat is tha three N twentieth year, tha word of tha LORD has come 2 me, N I have spoken 2 u, risin early N speakin; but y’all have not listened.
N tha LORD has sent 2 u all his servants tha prophets, risin early N sending ’em; but y’all have not listened, nor inclined ur ear 2 hear.
Dey said, Turn y’all again now every one from his evil way, N from tha evil of ur doings, N live in tha land dat tha LORD has given 2 u N 2 ur fathers 4 ever N ever:
N go not after other gods 2 serve ’em, N 2 worship ’em, N provoke me not 2 anger wit tha works of ur hands; N I will do u no hurt.
Yet y’all have not listened 2 me, says tha LORD; dat y’all might provoke me 2 anger wit tha works of ur hands 2 ur own hurt.
Therefore like dis says tha LORD of hosts; Because y’all have not heard my words,

Look, I will send N take all tha families of tha north, says tha LORD, N Nebuchadrezzar tha king of Babylon, my servant, N will bring ’em against dis land, N against tha inhabitants of it, N against all dese nations round about, N will utterly destroy ’em, N make ’em an astonishment, N an hissing, N perpetual desolations.
Moreover I will take from ’em tha voice of mirth, N tha voice of gladness, tha voice of tha bridegroom, N tha voice of tha bride, tha sound of tha millstones, N tha light of tha candle.
N dis whole land shall be a desolation, N an astonishment; N dese nations shall serve tha king of Babylon seventy years.

N it will happen, when seventy years r accomplished, dat I will punish tha king of Babylon, N dat nation, says tha LORD, 4 their iniquity, N tha land of tha Chaldeans, N will make it perpetual desolations.
N I will bring upon dat land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all dat is written in dis book, which Jeremiah has prophesied against all tha nations.
4 many nations N great kings shall serve themselves of ’em also: N I will recompense ’em according 2 their deeds, N according 2 tha works of their own hands.
4 like dis says tha LORD God of Israel 2 me; Take tha wine cup of dis fury at my hand, N cause all tha nations, 2 whom I send u, 2 drink it.
N dey shall drink, N be moved, N be mad, because of tha sword dat I will send among ’em.
Then took I tha cup at tha LORD’s hand, N made all tha nations 2 drink, 2 whom tha LORD had sent me:
2 wit, Jerusalem, N tha citiez of Judah, N tha kings of it, N tha princes of it, 2 make ’em a desolation, an astonishment, an hissing, N a curse; as it is dis day;
Pharaoh king of Egypt, N his servants, N his princes, N all his people;
N all tha mingled people, N all tha kings of tha land of Uz, N all tha kings of tha land of tha Philistines, N Ashkelon, N Azzah, N Ekron, N tha remnant of Ashdod,
Edom, N Moab, N tha children of Ammon,
N all tha kings of Tyrus, N all tha kings of Zidon, N tha kings of tha isles which r beyond tha sea,
Dedan, N Tema, N Buz, N all dat r in tha utmost corners,
N all tha kings of Arabia, N all tha kings of tha mingled people dat live in tha desert,
N all tha kings of Zimri, N all tha kings of Elam, N all tha kings of tha Medes,
N all tha kings of tha north, far N near, one wit another, N all tha kingdoms of tha world, which r upon tha face of tha earth: N tha king of Sheshach shall drink after ’em.
Therefore u will say 2 ’em, like dis says tha LORD of hosts, tha God of Israel; Drink y’all, N be drunken, N spue, N fall, N rise no more, because of tha sword which I will send among u.
N it will be, if dey refuse 2 take tha cup at thine hand 2 drink, then will u say 2 ’em, like dis says tha LORD of hosts; y’all shall certainly drink.

4, look, I begin 2 bring evil on tha city which is called by my name, N should y’all be utterly unpunished? y’all shall not be unpunished: 4 I will call 4 a sword upon all tha inhabitants of tha earth, says tha LORD of hosts.

Therefore prophesy u against ’em all dese words, N say 2 ’em, tha LORD shall roar from on high, N utter his voice from his holy habitation; he shall mightily roar upon his habitation; he shall give a shout, as dey dat tread tha grapes, against all tha inhabitants of tha earth.
A noise shall come even 2 tha ends of tha earth; 4 tha LORD has a controversy wit tha nations, he will plead wit all flesh; he will give ’em dat r wicked 2 tha sword, says tha LORD.
Like dis says tha LORD of hosts, look, evil shall go forth from nation 2 nation, N a great whirlwind shall be raised up from tha coasts of tha earth.
N tha killed of tha LORD shall be at dat day from one end of tha earth even 2 tha other end of tha earth: dey shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; dey shall be dung upon tha ground.
Howl, y’all shepherds, N cry; N wallow y’all in tha ashes, y’all principal of tha flock: 4 tha days of ur slaughter N of ur dispersions r accomplished; N y’all shall fall like a pleasant vessel.
N tha shepherds shall have no way 2 flee, nor tha principal of tha flock 2 escape.
A voice of tha cry of tha shepherds, N an howling of tha principal of tha flock, shall be heard: 4 tha LORD has spoiled their pasture.
N tha peaceable habitations r cut down because of tha fierce anger of tha LORD.
He has forsaken his covert, as tha lion: 4 their land is desolate because of tha fierceness of tha oppressor, N because of his fierce anger.

26.text: In tha beginning of tha reign of Jehoiakim tha son of Josiah king of Judah came dis word from tha LORD, sayin,

Like dis says tha LORD; Stand in tha court of tha LORD’s house, N speak 2 all tha citiez of Judah, which come 2 worship in tha LORD’s house, all tha words dat I command u 2 speak 2 ’em; diminish not a word:
If so be dey will listen, N turn every man from his evil way, dat I may repent me of tha evil, which I purpose 2 do 2 ’em because of tha evil of their doings.
N u will say 2 ’em, like dis says tha LORD; If y’all will not listen 2 me, 2 walk in my law, which I have set before u,
2 listen 2 tha words of my servants tha prophets, whom I sent 2 u, both risin up early, N sending ’em, but y’all have not listened;
Then will I make dis house like Shiloh, N will make dis city a curse 2 all tha nations of tha earth.
So tha priests N tha prophets N all tha people heard Jeremiah speakin dese words in tha house of tha LORD.

Now it happened, when Jeremiah had made an end of speakin all dat tha LORD had commanded him 2 speak 2 all tha people, dat tha priests N tha prophets N all tha people took him, sayin, u will surely die.

Why have u prophesied in tha name of tha LORD, sayin, dis house shall be like Shiloh, N dis city shall be desolate without an inhabitant? N all tha people were gathered against Jeremiah in tha house of tha LORD.
When tha princes of Judah heard dese things, then dey came up from tha king’s house 2 tha house of tha LORD, N sat down in tha entry of tha new gate of tha LORD’s house.
Then spoke tha priests N tha prophets 2 tha princes N 2 all tha people, sayin, dis man is worthy 2 die; 4 he has prophesied against dis city, as y’all have heard wit ur ears.
Then spoke Jeremiah 2 all tha princes N 2 all tha people, sayin, tha LORD sent me 2 prophesy against dis house N against dis city all tha words dat y’all have heard.
Therefore now amend ur ways N ur doings, N obey tha voice of tha LORD ur God; N tha LORD will repent him of tha evil dat he has pronounced against u.
As 4 me, look, I am in ur hand: do wit me as seems good N meet 2 u.

But know y’all 4 certain, dat if y’all put me 2 death, y’all shall surely bring innocent blood upon y’all, N upon dis city, N upon tha inhabitants of it: 4 of a truth tha LORD has sent me 2 u 2 speak all dese words in ur ears.
Then said tha princes N all tha people 2 tha priests N 2 tha prophets; dis man is not worthy 2 die: 4 he has spoken 2 us in tha name of tha LORD our God.
Then rose up certain of tha elders of tha land, N spoke 2 all tha assembly of tha people, sayin,

Micah tha Morasthite prophesied in tha days of Hezekiah king of Judah, N spoke 2 all tha people of Judah, sayin, like dis says tha LORD of hosts; Zion shall be plowed like a field, N Jerusalem shall become heaps, N tha mountain of tha house as tha high places of a forest.

Did Hezekiah king of Judah N all Judah put him at all 2 death? did he not fear tha LORD, N besought tha LORD, N tha LORD repented him of tha evil which he had pronounced against ’em? like dis might we procure great evil against our souls., N tha: Heb. tha face of tha LORD, etc
N there was also a man dat prophesied in tha name of tha LORD, Urijah tha son of Shemaiah of Kirjath-jearim, who prophesied against dis city N against dis land according 2 all tha words of Jeremiah:
N when Jehoiakim tha king, wit all his mighty men, N all tha princes, heard his words, tha king sought 2 put him 2 death: but when Urijah heard it, he was afraid, N fled, N went in2 Egypt;
N Jehoiakim tha king sent men in2 Egypt, namely, Elnathan tha son of Achbor, N certain men wit him in2 Egypt.
N dey fetched forth Urijah out of Egypt, N brought him 2 Jehoiakim tha king; who killed him wit tha sword, N cast his dead body in2 tha graves of tha common people.
Nevertheless tha hand of Ahikam tha son of Shaphan was wit Jeremiah, dat dey should not give him in2 tha hand of tha people 2 put him 2 death.

27.text: In tha beginning of tha reign of Jehoiakim tha son of Josiah king of Judah came dis word 2 Jeremiah from tha LORD, sayin,
Like dis says tha LORD 2 me; Make u bonds N yokes, N put ’em upon ur neck, said

N send ’em 2 tha king of Edom, N 2 tha king of Moab, N 2 tha king of tha Ammonites, N 2 tha king of Tyrus, N 2 tha king of Zidon, by tha hand of tha messengers which come 2 Jerusalem 2 Zedekiah king of Judah;
N command ’em 2 say 2 their masters, like dis says tha LORD of hosts, tha God of Israel; like dis shall y’all say 2 ur masters;
I have made tha earth, tha man N tha beast dat r upon tha ground, by my great power N by my outstretched arm, N have given it 2 whom it seemed meet 2 me.
N now have I given all dese lands in2 tha hand of Nebuchadnezzar tha king of Babylon, my servant; N tha beasts of tha field have I given him also 2 serve him.
N all nations shall serve him, N his son, N his son’s son, until tha very time of his land come: N then many nations N great kings shall serve themselves of him.

N it will happen, dat tha nation N kingdom which will not serve tha same Nebuchadnezzar tha king of Babylon, N dat will not put their neck under tha yoke of tha king of Babylon, dat nation will I punish, says tha LORD, wit tha sword, N wit tha famine, N wit tha pestilence, until I have consumed ’em by his hand.
Therefore listen not y’all 2 ur prophets, nor 2 ur diviners, nor 2 ur dreamers, nor 2 ur enchanters, nor 2 ur sorcerers, which speak 2 u, sayin, y’all shall not serve tha king of Babylon:
4 dey prophesy a lie 2 u, 2 remove u far from ur land; N dat I should drive u out, N y’all should perish.
But tha nations dat bring their neck under tha yoke of tha king of Babylon, N serve him, dose will I let remain still in their own land, says tha LORD; N dey shall till it, N live in it.
I spoke also 2 Zedekiah king of Judah according 2 all dese words, sayin, Bring ur necks under tha yoke of tha king of Babylon, N serve him N his people, N live.
Why will y’all die, u N ur people, by tha sword, by tha famine, N by tha pestilence, as tha LORD has spoken against tha nation dat will not serve tha king of Babylon?
Therefore listen not 2 tha words of tha prophets dat speak 2 u, sayin, y’all shall not serve tha king of Babylon: 4 dey prophesy a lie 2 u.
4 I have not sent ’em, says tha LORD, yet dey prophesy a lie in my name; dat I might drive u out, N dat y’all might perish, y’all, N tha prophets dat prophesy 2 u.

Also I spoke 2 tha priests N 2 all dis people, sayin, like dis says tha LORD; listen not 2 tha words of ur prophets dat prophesy 2 u, sayin, look, tha vessels of tha LORD’s house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon: 4 dey prophesy a lie 2 u.
Listen not 2 ’em; serve tha king of Babylon, N live: so should dis city be laid waste?

But if dey be prophets, N if tha word of tha LORD be wit ’em, let ’em now make intercession 2 tha LORD of hosts, dat tha vessels which r left in tha house of tha LORD, N in tha house of tha king of Judah, N at Jerusalem, go not 2 Babylon.
4 like dis says tha LORD of hosts concerning tha pillars, N concerning tha sea, N concerning tha bases, N concerning tha residue of tha vessels dat remain in dis city,
Which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not, when he carried away captive Jeconiah tha son of Jehoiakim king of Judah from Jerusalem 2 Babylon, N all tha nobles of Judah N Jerusalem;
Yeah, like dis says tha LORD of hosts, tha God of Israel, concerning tha vessels dat remain in tha house of tha LORD, N in tha house of tha king of Judah N of Jerusalem;
Dey shall be carried 2 Babylon, N there shall dey be until tha day dat I visit ’em, says tha LORD; then will I bring ’em up, N restore ’em 2 dis place.

28.text: N it happened tha same year, in tha beginning of tha reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in tha fourth year, N in tha fifth month, dat Hananiah tha son of Azur tha prophet, which was of Gibeon, spoke 2 me in tha house of tha LORD, in tha presence of tha priests N of all tha people, sayin,

N I will bring again 2 dis place Jeconiah tha son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, wit all tha captives of Judah, dat went in2 Babylon, says tha LORD: 4 I will break tha yoke of tha king of Babylon.
Then tha prophet Jeremiah said 2 tha prophet Hananiah in tha presence of tha priests, N in tha presence of all tha people dat stood in tha house of tha LORD,

Nevertheless hear u now dis word dat I speak in thine ears, N in tha ears of all tha people;
Tha prophets dat have been before me N before u of old prophesied both against many countries, N against great kingdoms, of war, N of evil, N of pestilence.

Then Hananiah tha prophet took tha yoke from off tha prophet Jeremiah’s neck, N broke it.

Then tha word of tha LORD came 2 Jeremiah tha prophet, after dat Hananiah tha prophet had broken tha yoke from off tha neck of tha prophet Jeremiah, sayin,
Go N tell Hananiah, sayin, like dis says tha LORD; u have broken tha yokes of wood; but u will make 4 ’em yokes of iron.

4 like dis says tha LORD of hosts, tha God of Israel; I have put a yoke of iron upon tha neck of all dese nations, dat dey may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; N dey shall serve him: N I have given him tha beasts of tha field also.
Then said tha prophet Jeremiah 2 Hananiah tha prophet, Hear now, Hananiah; tha LORD has not sent u; but u make dis people 2 trust in a lie.
Therefore like dis says tha LORD; look, I will cast u from off tha face of tha earth: dis year u will die, because u have taught rebellion against tha LORD.

29.text: Now dese r tha words of tha letter dat Jeremiah tha prophet sent from Jerusalem 2 tha residue of tha elders which were carried away captives, N 2 tha priests, N 2 tha prophets, N 2 all tha people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem 2 Babylon;
(After dat Jeconiah tha king, N tha queen, N tha eunuchs, tha princes of Judah N Jerusalem, N tha carpenters, N tha smiths, were departed from Jerusalem;)
By tha hand of Elasah tha son of Shaphan, N Gemariah tha son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent 2 Babylon 2 Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon) sayin,
Like dis says tha LORD of hosts, tha God of Israel, 2 all dat r carried away captives, whom I have caused 2 be carried away from Jerusalem 2 Babylon;
Build y’all houses, N live in ’em; N plant gardens, N eat tha fruit of ’em;
Take y’all wives, N beget sons N daughters; N take wives 4 ur sons, N give ur daughters 2 husbands, dat dey may bear sons N daughters; dat y’all may be increased there, N not diminished.
N seek tha peace of tha city where I have caused u 2 be carried away captives, N pray 2 tha LORD 4 it: 4 in tha peace of it shall y’all have peace.
4 like dis says tha LORD of hosts, tha God of Israel; don’t let ur prophets N ur diviners, dat be in tha midst of u, deceive u, neither listen 2 ur dreams which y’all cause 2 be dreamed.
4 dey prophesy falsely 2 u in my name: I have not sent ’em, says tha LORD.
4 like dis says tha LORD, dat after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit u, N perform my good word toward u, in causing u 2 return 2 dis place.
4 I know tha thoughts dat I think toward u, says tha LORD, thoughts of peace, N not of evil, 2 give u an expected end.
Then shall y’all call upon me, N y’all shall go N pray 2 me, N I will listen 2 u.
N y’all shall seek me, N find me, when y’all shall search 4 me wit all ur heart.

N I will be found of u, says tha LORD: N I will turn away ur captivity, N I will gather u from all tha nations, N from all tha places where I have driven u, says tha LORD; N I will bring u again in2 tha place from where I caused u 2 be carried away captive.
Because y’all have said, tha LORD has raised us up prophets in Babylon;
Know dat like dis says tha LORD of tha king dat sits upon tha throne of David, N of all tha people dat lives in dis city, N of ur brothers dat r not gone forth wit u in2 captivity;
Like dis says tha LORD of hosts; look, I will send upon ’em tha sword, tha famine, N tha pestilence, N will make ’em like vile figs, dat cannot be eaten, dey r so evil.

N I will persecute ’em wit tha sword, wit tha famine, N wit tha pestilence, N will deliver ’em 2 be removed 2 all tha kingdoms of tha earth, 2 be a curse, N an astonishment, N an hissing, N a reproach, among all tha nations where I have driven ’em:
Because dey have not listened 2 my words, says tha LORD, which I sent 2 ’em by my servants tha prophets, risin up early N sending ’em; but y’all would not hear, says tha LORD.
Hear y’all therefore tha word of tha LORD, all y’all of tha captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem 2 Babylon:

Like dis says tha LORD of hosts, tha God of Israel, of Ahab tha son of Kolaiah, N of Zedekiah tha son of Maaseiah, which prophesy a lie 2 u in my name; look, I will deliver ’em in2 tha hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; N he shall kill ’em before ur eyes;
N of ’em shall be taken up a curse by all tha captivity of Judah which r in Babylon, sayin, tha LORD make u like Zedekiah N like Ahab, whom tha king of Babylon roasted in tha fire;

Because dey have committed villany in Israel, N have committed adultery wit their neighbours’ wives, N have spoken lyin words in my name, which I have not commanded ’em; even I know, N am a witness, says tha LORD.
Like dis will u also speak 2 Shemaiah tha Nehelamite, sayin,

Like dis speaks tha LORD of hosts, tha God of Israel, sayin, Because u have sent letters in ur name 2 all tha people dat r at Jerusalem, N 2 Zephaniah tha son of Maaseiah tha priest, N 2 all tha priests, sayin,

Tha LORD has made u priest in tha stead of Jehoiada tha priest, dat y’all should be officers in tha house of tha LORD, 4 every man dat is mad, N makes himself a prophet, dat u should put him in prison, N in tha stocks.
Now therefore why have u not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth, which makes himself a prophet 2 u?
4 therefore he sent 2 us in Babylon, sayin, dis captivity is long: build y’all houses, N live in ’em; N plant gardens, N eat tha fruit of ’em.
N Zephaniah tha priest read dis letter in tha ears of Jeremiah tha prophet.
Then came tha word of tha LORD 2 Jeremiah, sayin,
Send 2 all ’em of tha captivity, sayin, like dis says tha LORD concerning Shemaiah tha Nehelamite; Because dat Shemaiah has prophesied 2 u, N I sent him not, N he caused u 2 trust in a lie:

Therefore like dis says tha LORD; look, I will punish Shemaiah tha Nehelamite, N his seed: he shall not have a man 2 live among dis people; neither shall he look tha good dat I will do 4 my people, says tha LORD; because he has taught rebellion against tha LORD.

30.text: Tha word dat came 2 Jeremiah from tha LORD, sayin,
Like dis speaks tha LORD God of Israel, sayin, Write u all tha words dat I have spoken 2 u in a book.

4, look, tha days come, says tha LORD, dat I will bring again tha captivity of my people Israel N Judah, says tha LORD: N I will cause ’em 2 return 2 tha land dat I gave 2 their fathers, N dey shall possess it.
N dese r tha words dat tha LORD spoke concerning Israel N concerning Judah.

Alas! 4 dat day is great, so dat none is like it: it is even tha time of Jacob’s trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.

But dey shall serve tha LORD their God, N David their king, whom I will raise up 2 ’em.

Therefore fear u not, O my servant Jacob, says tha LORD; neither be dismayed, O Israel: 4, look, I will save u from afar, N ur seed from tha land of their captivity; N Jacob shall return, N shall be in rest, N be quiet, N none shall make him afraid.

4 I am wit u, says tha LORD, 2 save u: though I make a full end of all nations where I have scattered u, yet will I not make a full end of u: but I will correct u in measure, N will not leave u altogether unpunished.
4 like dis says tha LORD, ur bruise is incurable, N ur wound is grievous.

N I charged Baruch before ’em, sayin,

Like dis says tha LORD of hosts, tha God of Israel; Take dese evidences, dis evidence of tha purchase, both which is sealed, N dis evidence which is open; N put ’em in an earthen vessel, dat dey may continue many days.
4 like dis says tha LORD of hosts, tha God of Israel; Houses N fields N vineyards shall be possessed again in dis land.

Ah Lord GOD! look, u have made tha heaven N tha earth by ur great power N stretched out arm, N there is nothing too hard 4 u:
u show lovingkindness 2 thousands, N recompensest tha iniquity of tha fathers in2 tha bosom of their children after ’em: tha Great, tha Mighty God, tha LORD of hosts, is his name,

Which have set signs N wonders in tha land of Egypt, even 2 dis day, N in Israel, N among other men; N have made u a name, as at dis day;
N have brought forth ur people Israel out of tha land of Egypt wit signs, N wit wonders, N wit a strong hand, N wit a stretched out arm, N wit great terror;

N dey came in, N possessed it; but dey obeyed not ur voice, neither walked in ur law; dey have done nothing of all dat u commandedst ’em 2 do: therefore u have caused all dis evil 2 come upon ’em:

Look tha mounts, dey r come 2 tha city 2 take it; N tha city is given in2 tha hand of tha Chaldeans, dat fight against it, because of tha sword, N of tha famine, N of tha pestilence: N what u have spoken is come 2 pass; N, look, u see it.

Then came tha word of tha LORD 2 Jeremiah, sayin,
Look, I am tha LORD, tha God of all flesh: is there any thing too hard 4 me?
Therefore like dis says tha LORD; look, I will give dis city in2 tha hand of tha Chaldeans, N in2 tha hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, N he shall take it:

N dey built tha high places of Baal, which r in tha valley of tha son of Hinnom, 2 cause their sons N their daughters 2 pass through tha fire 2 Molech; which I commanded ’em not, neither came it in2 my mind, dat dey should do dis abomination, 2 cause Judah 2 sin.

N now therefore like dis says tha LORD, tha God of Israel, concerning dis city, whereof y’all say, It shall be delivered in2 tha hand of tha king of Babylon by tha sword, N by tha famine, N by tha pestilence;
